synopsis: SIMPHERA is a commercial tool for scenario generation, test management and orchestration of scenario-based testing at scale; paired with AURELION, it is presented as a complete or near-complete simulation platform [f9203, f8362, f8447, f8348]. The combined offering lists camera, ray-traced radar, lidar, infrared and ultrasonic models, plus integration with dSPACE benches and an OSI-compatible SIL/HIL chain [f15896, f15897, f8999]. The latest releases found were SIMPHERA 26.2 on 9 July 2026 and AURELION 26.2 on 15 July 2026 [f9001, f9207]. Evidence is on-road only: no public evidence validates quarry or mining terrain, material or weather fidelity, and terrain physics must come from elsewhere [f8454, f8455, f8997]. The platform appears among examples for the highest-cost tool chain, but no public price was found, so that positioning is not a published quotation [f9303, f9000, f9206].
